ch: At the top, a helper line says in plain words what is left today.
For family far away, open Settings and choose Let someone know I'm OK.
If a card says not today, it isn't due today, so it can't break the run.
Under What is it, type a few words, like Walk to the corner.
To change or remove a card later, tap Change or remove a card, then the card's name.
Now the button called Settings, I'm OK text, day off.
Then the app gets a short text ready: I'm OK, and what was done today.
Setting up Every Day takes about five minutes.
Step two: to make your own, tap Add a card.
Step five: tap Settings, I'm OK text, day off.
Step six: each day, tap a card as soon as it is done.
To see how a card has gone, open Change or remove a card and tap history next to it.
